note: Manual corrections applied after the roster build so they always win over Liquipedia (which sometimes links the wrong or an old account). Keyed by player id (slug of team-name). steamId64 fixes a wrong Steam link; epic names a player who does not play on Steam at all, and takes precedence over any Steam id. Epic names are CASE SENSITIVE and tracker.gg answers 200 for an account that exists but has never played, so a wrong one shows as a real profile with zero games rather than as an error.
